trap-nonspeakable.notes: TWO RIGOR FLAGS. (1) MATH ERROR in Part 3: the block asserts the Frobenius self-pairing equals Geom(beta) divided by Geom(beta-mirror) and equals 1, while giving in the same sentence the inputs Vol_q(mirror) = Vol_q and CS_q(mirror) = -CS_q. Those inputs give Geom(mirror) = Vol_q/hbar^2 - CS_q hbar^2, so the ratio is (V/h2 + C h2)/(V/h2 - C h2), which is 1 only when CS_q = 0. In the algebraic-torus regime, where Vol_q vanishes and CS_q carries everything, the ratio is -1. The identity therefore holds on the CS-free (hyperbolic and trivial) regimes only, which is also the only case the amphicheiral corollary uses. Proposed: 'Geom(mirror) = Geom(beta) whenever CS_q = 0, hence the self-pairing is +1 on the hyperbolic and trivial regimes and -1 on the torus regime.' (2) KIND MISMATCH: the .ts declares conjecture() with label conj:geom-yekutieli-alignment, but the .md presents 'Proposition (conditional on ...)' followed by 'Proof.' and a QED box, and lean.validation is 'not_checked'. A conjecture block should not carry a completed proof: either promote it to prop: under the 3b-cond conditional-class pattern (which requires the conjecture class as an explicit hypothesis in the Lean signature), or relabel the narrative as a proof SKETCH.
